# NETWORK ANALYSIS : NMI & CCA

#1. NMI

## D1 
### ITS

```{r}
NPERM=1000 #000#set quite low, so that permutations do not take too long, only for proof of principle, set to 10000 for serious comparisons

# # Import simulated clustering MPC
# netBin.config<-simulate(nullmodel(FB_D1_16S,"curveball"),nsim=NPERM)
# graph.bin.gut.config<-simulate(nullmodel(FB_D1_16S,"curveball"),nsim=NPERM)
# 
# graph.bin.bpk.config<-simulate(nullmodel(FB_D1_16S,"curveball"),nsim=NPERM)

# Parallelized version
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)
sim_fun <- function(i, FB) {
  simulate(nullmodel(FB, "curveball"), nsim = 1)}

#Charge matrix
FB_D1_ITS <- read.csv(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data","5_SBMclustering", "Dataset_1", "FB_D1_ITS.csv"),header=TRUE, sep=",", row.names = 1)

load("SBM_memberships_16S_D1.RData")


netBin.config.ITS <- future_lapply(seq_len(NPERM), future.seed=TRUE, sim_fun, FB = FB_D1_ITS)

graph.bin.ITSe.config <- future_lapply(seq_len(NPERM), future.seed=TRUE, sim_fun,  FB = FB_D1_ITS)
```

```{r}
# Factors
FT_vect_D1_ITS <- as.factor(mtd_D1_ITS$FruitType[match(rownames(FB_D1_ITS), rownames(mtd_D1_ITS))])

ST_vect_D1_ITS <- as.factor(mtd_D1_ITS$SampleType[match(rownames(FB_D1_ITS), rownames(mtd_D1_ITS))])

FS_vect_D1_ITS <- as.factor(mtd_D1_ITS$FruitSite[match(rownames(FB_D1_ITS), rownames(mtd_D1_ITS))])

# Observed
nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitType <- compare(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_ITS_D1), FT_vect_D1_ITS, method = "nmi")

nmi_obs_expe_ITS_SampleType <- compare(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_ITS_D1), ST_vect_D1_ITS, method = "nmi")

nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitSite <- compare(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_ITS_D1), FS_vect_D1_ITS, method = "nmi")

## Simulated clustering
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)

simulated_clustering_expe_ITS <- Simulate_Clustering_SBM(FB = FB_D1_ITS, NPERM, name = "simulated_clustering_D1_ITS.tsv")

# Simulated NMI
# Fruit Type
simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_FT <- 
simulated_clustering_expe_ITS %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Simulation", values_to = "Memberships") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Simulation) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., nmi_sim = compare(as.factor(Memberships), FT_vect_D1_ITS, method = "nmi"))

print(c("NMI =", nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitType, "P-value = ", 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_FT$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitType)))
pval_ITS_FT <- 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_FT$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitType)


# Sample Type (Life Stage)
simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_ST <- 
simulated_clustering_expe_ITS %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Simulation", values_to = "Memberships") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Simulation) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., nmi_sim = compare(as.factor(Memberships), ST_vect_D1_ITS, method = "nmi"))

print(c("NMI =", nmi_obs_expe_ITS_SampleType, "P-value = ", 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_ST$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_expe_ITS_SampleType)))
pval_ITS_ST <- 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_ST$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_expe_ITS_SampleType)


# Fruit Site
simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_FS <- 
simulated_clustering_expe_ITS %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Simulation", values_to = "Memberships") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Simulation) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., nmi_sim = compare(as.factor(Memberships), FS_vect_D1_ITS, method = "nmi"))

print(c("NMI =", nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitSite, "P-value = ", 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_FS$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitSite)))
pval_ITS_FS <- 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_FS$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitSite)


# Compil & export in a table
results_table_ITS <- data.frame(
  Marker  = "ITS",
  Factor  = c("FruitType", "SampleType", "FruitSite"),
  NMI     = c(nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitType, nmi_obs_expe_ITS_SampleType, nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitSite),
  p_value = c(pval_ITS_FT, pval_ITS_ST, pval_ITS_FS),
  Npermutation  = NPERM)

write.csv(results_table_ITS, file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data","6_NMI_CCA", "Dataset_1", "Results_NMI_ITS_D1_60.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
```

#2. CCA

## D1

### ITS

```{r}
NPERM <- 100

sim_list = list()
  
#for each rarefied matrix
  sim_mat <- BF_D1_ITS
  #produce NPERM simulated graphs
  netBin.config <-
    simulate(vegan::nullmodel(as.data.frame(sim_mat), "curveball"), nsim = NPERM)

  LBM.config <-
    sapply(1:NPERM, function(i) {
      BF_sim <- netBin.config[, , i]
      FB_sim <- t(BF_sim)
      LBM_sim <-as.matrix(FB_sim) %>%
    sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli',
                         estimOptions = list(plot = F))
       memb_spl_sim <- LBM_sim$memberships$row ## Extract membership of the samples 
    })
  
  
# parallelized version
plan(multisession, workers = detectCores() - 1) # choose nb of cores

# Fonction à paralléliser
sim_one <- function(i) {
  p()
  BF_sim <- netBin.config[, , i]
  FB_sim <- t(BF_sim)
  LBM_sim <- sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(as.matrix(FB_sim), model = 'bernoulli', estimOptions = list(plot = FALSE))
  memb_spl_sim <- LBM_sim$memberships$row
  return(memb_spl_sim)}

# Lancer la simulation (à faire une seule fois avant la boucle)
netBin.config <- simulate(vegan::nullmodel(as.data.frame(sim_mat), "curveball"), nsim = NPERM)

# Paralléliser la boucle
LBM.config <- with_progress({
  p <- progressor(along = 1:NPERM)
  future_sapply(1:NPERM, function(i) {
    p()
    sim_one(i)}) })
```

```{r}
# Factors
FruitType_vect_ITS_D1 <- as.factor(mtd_D1_ITS$FruitType[match(rownames(FB_D1_ITS), mtd_D1_ITS$Sample)])
SampleType_vect_ITS_D1 <- as.factor(mtd_D1_ITS$SampleType[match(rownames(FB_D1_ITS), mtd_D1_ITS$Sample)])

## Create a matrix with samples as rows and group asigned by the latent block model as column
dummyMod_ITS_D1 <- lme4::dummy(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_ITS_D1), levelsToKeep = levels(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_ITS_D1)))

## Creates dataframe with the two variables of interest
cca_data_ITS_D1 <- data.frame("FruitType" = as.factor(FruitType_vect_ITS_D1),
    "SampleType" = as.factor(SampleType_vect_ITS_D1))

## Partition the variation of the community matrix
varp_ITS_D1 <- vegan::varpart(dummyMod_ITS_D1, cca_data_ITS_D1$FruitType, cca_data_ITS_D1$SampleType, chisquare = T)
varp_ITS_D1$part

#CCA with line randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_NULL_ITS_D1 <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_D1_ITS), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_ITS_D1, var1=cca_data_ITS_D1$FruitType, var2=cca_data_ITS_D1$SampleType, configs = NULL)

write.xlsx(wholenetwork_cca_results_NULL_ITS_D1, file=here::here("data", "derived_data","6_NMI_CCA", "Dataset_1", "CCA_NULL_ITS_D1.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE)

#CCA with full randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_CONFIGS_ITS_D1 <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_D1_ITS), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_ITS_D1, var1=cca_data_ITS_D1$FruitType, var2=cca_data_ITS_D1$SampleType, configs = LBM.config)

write.xlsx(wholenetwork_cca_results_CONFIGS_ITS_D1, file=here::here("data", "derived_data","6_NMI_CCA", "Dataset_1", "CCA_CONFIGS_ITS_D1.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE)
```

## D2

### 16S

```{r}
NPERM <- 1000

sim_list = list()
  
#for each rarefied matrix
  sim_mat <- BF_D2_16S
  # #produce NPERM simulated graphs
  # netBin.config <-
  #   simulate(vegan::nullmodel(as.data.frame(sim_mat), "curveball"), nsim = NPERM)
  # 
  # LBM.config <-
  #   sapply(1:NPERM, function(i) {
  #     BF_sim <- netBin.config[, , i]
  #     FB_sim <- t(BF_sim)
  #     LBM_sim <-as.matrix(FB_sim) %>%
  #   sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli',
  #                        estimOptions = list(plot = T))
  #      memb_spl_sim <- LBM_sim$memberships$row ## Extract membership of the samples 
  #   })


# Activer le parallélisme
plan(multisession, workers = detectCores() - 1)

# Fonction à paralléliser (sans p())
sim_one <- function(i) {
  p()
  BF_sim <- netBin.config[, , i]
  FB_sim <- t(BF_sim)
  LBM_sim <- sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(
    as.matrix(FB_sim),
    model = 'poisson',
    estimOptions = list(plot = FALSE, maxIter = 1000, nbBlocks = 4)
  )
  memb_spl_sim <- LBM_sim$memberships$row
  return(memb_spl_sim)
}

# Lancer la simulation
netBin.config <- simulate(vegan::nullmodel(as.data.frame(sim_mat), "curveball"), nsim = NPERM)

# Paralléliser la boucle avec progression
LBM.config <- with_progress({
  p <- progressor(along = 1:NPERM)
  future_sapply(1:NPERM, function(i) {
    p()  # Ici, p() est appelé dans le processus principal
    sim_one(i)
  })
})
```

```{r}
# Factors
FruitType_vect_16S_D2 <- as.factor(mtd_D2_16S$FruitType[match(rownames(FB_D2_16S), mtd_D2_16S$Sample)])

FruitSite_vect_16S_D2 <- as.factor(mtd_D2_16S$FruitSite[match(rownames(FB_D2_16S), mtd_D2_16S$Sample)])

dummyMod_16S_D2 <- lme4::dummy(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_16S_D2), levelsToKeep = levels(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_16S_D2)))

## Creates dataframe with the two variables of interest
cca_data_16S_D2 <- data.frame("FruitType" = as.factor(FruitType_vect_16S_D2),
    "FruitSite" = as.factor(FruitSite_vect_16S_D2))

## Partition the variation of the community matrix
varp_16S_D2 <- vegan::varpart(dummyMod_16S_D2, cca_data_16S_D2$FruitType, cca_data_16S_D2$FruitSite, chisquare = T)
varp_16S_D2$part

#CCA with line randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_NULL_16S_D2 <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_D2_16S), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_16S_D2, var1=cca_data_16S_D2$FruitType, var2=cca_data_16S_D2$FruitSite, configs = NULL)

write.xlsx(wholenetwork_cca_results_NULL_16S_D2, file=here::here("data", "derived_data","6_NMI_CCA", "Dataset_2", "CCA_NULL_16S_D2.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE)

#CCA with full randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_CONFIGS_16S_D2 <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_D2_16S), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_16S_D2, var1=cca_data_16S_D2$FruitType, var2=cca_data_16S_D2$FruitSite, configs = LBM.config)

write.xlsx(wholenetwork_cca_results_CONFIGS_16S_D2, file=here::here("data", "derived_data","6_NMI_CCA", "Dataset_2", "CCA_CONFIGS_16S_D2.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE)
```

```{r}
NPERM <- 100

sim_list = list()
  
#for each rarefied matrix
  sim_mat <- BF_D2_ITS
  #produce NPERM simulated graphs
  netBin.config <-
    simulate(vegan::nullmodel(as.data.frame(sim_mat), "curveball"), nsim = NPERM)

  LBM.config <-
    sapply(1:NPERM, function(i) {
      BF_sim <- netBin.config[, , i]
      FB_sim <- t(BF_sim)
      LBM_sim <-as.matrix(FB_sim) %>%
    sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli',
                         estimOptions = list(plot = T))
       memb_spl_sim <- LBM_sim$memberships$row ## Extract membership of the samples 
    })
```

```{r}
# Factors
FruitType_vect_ITS_D2 <- as.factor(mtd_D2_ITS$FruitType[match(rownames(FB_D2_ITS), mtd_D2_ITS$Sample)])
FruitSite_vect_ITS_D2 <- as.factor(mtd_D2_ITS$FruitSite[match(rownames(FB_D2_ITS), mtd_D2_ITS$Sample)])

## Create a matrix with samples as rows and group asigned by the latent block model as column
dummyMod_ITS_D2 <- lme4::dummy(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_ITS_D2), levelsToKeep = levels(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_ITS_D2)))

## Creates dataframe with the two variables of interest
cca_data_ITS_D2 <- data.frame("FruitType" = as.factor(FruitType_vect_ITS_D2),
    "FruitSite" = as.factor(FruitSite_vect_ITS_D2))

## Partition the variation of the community matrix
varp_ITS_D2 <- vegan::varpart(dummyMod_ITS_D2, cca_data_ITS_D2$FruitType, cca_data_ITS_D2$FruitSite, chisquare = T)
varp_ITS_D2$part

#CCA with line randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_NULL_ITS_D2 <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_D2_ITS), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_ITS_D2, var1=cca_data_ITS_D2$FruitType, var2=cca_data_ITS_D2$FruitSite, configs = NULL)

write.xlsx(wholenetwork_cca_results_NULL_ITS_D2, file=here::here("data", "derived_data","6_NMI_CCA", "Dataset_2", "CCA_NULL_ITS_D2.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE)

#CCA with full randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_CONFIGS_ITS_D2 <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_D2_ITS), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_ITS_D2, var1=cca_data_ITS_D2$FruitType, var2=cca_data_ITS_D2$FruitSite, configs = LBM.config)

write.xlsx(wholenetwork_cca_results_CONFIGS_ITS_D2, file=here::here("data", "derived_data","6_NMI_CCA", "Dataset_2", "CCA_CONFIGS_ITS_D2.xlsx"), rowNames = TRUE)
```
